description: This file provides formatting utility functions for date, currency, number, initials, and phone number formatting within a Django-based CRM frontend. The functions are designed for consistent data display across the application.

methods.name: formatDate(date, formatStr = 'MMM d, yyyy')
methods.description: Formats a date string or Date object into a human-readable string using date-fns, defaulting to 'MMM d, yyyy'. Returns '-' if the input is falsy or invalid.

methods.name: formatRelativeDate(date)
methods.description: Returns a relative time string (e.g., '2 hours ago') from a date, or '-' if the date is falsy or invalid.

methods.name: formatCurrency(amount, currency = 'USD', compact = false)
methods.description: Formats a number, string, or null/undefined as a currency string in USD or specified currency, with options for compact notation and handling invalid input.

methods.name: formatNumber(num)
methods.description: Formats a number with commas for thousands separator. Returns '-' if input is null or undefined.

methods.name: getInitials(name, maxLength = 2)
methods.description: Extracts and uppercases initials from a full name string, limited by maxLength (default 2).

methods.name: getNameInitials(firstName, lastName)
methods.description: Creates initials from first and last name strings by taking their first characters and uppercasing.

methods.name: formatPhone(phone)
methods.description: Formats a 10-digit phone number string into (XXX) XXX-XXXX format; returns original if not 10 digits.
